name: langflow
author: langflow
description: Follow langflow runs (fixed, gated agent workflows) in a panel: run list, graph, live log, memory; answer a run's gate.

enablement.purpose: Start `langflow web --api-only` in this workspace (only when it has .langflow/config.toml) so the langflow panel can list runs and answer gates. The server binds 127.0.0.1 and stops with the workspace.
